title: Component Part 2.2: live parameter-passing — author componentParameters reach the runtime instance
description: Build on Part 2.1 (task 1231, commit 8618411) which made a self-authored mx.controls.Button render+react (Ruffle-confirmed registerClass binding). Currently the author's label is STATICALLY seeded into the EditText at compile time; the broader componentParameters (on the SymbolInstance model, editable in the Component Inspector from task 1222) are NOT delivered to the runtime instance. PART 2.2: make author-configured componentParameters reach the live component at runtime, GENERALLY (not just Button.label). Approach (verify best fit against the code): for each placed component instance, after it is placed, emit a per-instance DoAction (or PlaceObject2 init mechanism) that sets the instance's parameters on the registered class instance (e.g. _root.<instanceName>.setLabel(...) / assign properties) using the componentParameters map; ensure the placed sprite has an instance name so the script can target it. Keep it generic over the parameter set defined in the component catalog (packages/core/src/model/components.ts). VERIFY: Ruffle oracle (apps/desktop/e2e) — set a non-default label (and another param) in the model, publish, confirm the rendered/queried runtime value reflects the author's param (not the default); plus a structural unit test (decode own SWF) that the per-instance param DoAction/init is emitted with the right values. Self-verifiable without a real-Flash fixture. Build+tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixture failures acceptable). Scope: packages/swf/src/compiler/components.ts (+ frames.ts per-instance script emission, doInitAction/DoAction helpers, component-place.test.ts, e2e). Update docs/13. NOTE: this is the last broadly-applicable Part-2 slice planned for now; further control families (CheckBox/RadioButton/List/etc.) are gated on demand.
